physical_contract: unchanged p3-main-v3 physical v4/acceptance-v1; task goal [0.08,0,0], 5mm/3deg and measured low speeds for >=0.3s, max30s, retries0
data: unchanged 90 families, train60/validation30, original train3200/validation1600; no new collection required
learning: three seeds, K5, two lambda candidates, matched1000 additional updates/branch; nine training branches

E2.test_generation: P5-01 only; canonical initial pose/pusher identity disjoint from train/validation/previous development; outcomes never guide replacement
E2.normal_failures: retain timeout/planner_invalid/workspace and physics failures with original denominator; unresolved infrastructure blocks complete evaluation

E1.family_selection: first two final families by fixed ID in each stratum; selected before results
E1.snapshot_source: G actual E2 path before decision; full physical+task+actual previous action+G context+RNG; warm None shared
E1.missing_snapshot: record unavailable and stop E1 completion; no successful-family substitution
E1.future_rule: independent offline physical replay from same complete snapshot, once per candidate shared by all seven learned model instances; never fed into online planning
E1.limits: N32 diagnostic candidate set differs from online N128; 12 snapshots are six independent families, no full-N optimality claim

E3: same S1/SK raw E1/E2 contrasts with other settings matched; no redundant physics benchmark

statistics.unit: family within stratum, common resample across models; seed averages first within each family plus each seed separately
statistics.limitations: four families per E2 stratum and two per E1 stratum; exploratory uncertainty, no power/equivalence or industrial population guarantee; intervals do not cover all training-seed variation

P4_development_resource_allowance: up to eight 30s controller-case executions, including failure replay and single-change hypotheses; revise resource estimate first if more needed
P5_replay_application_resource_allowance: one predeclared final family replay and one separate new same-range initial family, all eight controllers, up to16 episodes; no OOD/new-task claim

storage.multiplier_is: planning allowance, not measured worst-case bound
storage.new_recording: all original StepResult fields and initial snapshot compressed losslessly, all applied/requested commands and raw substeps retained; every plan compact replay inputs/hash and predeclared full snapshots/invalid trace
storage.guard: before each stage remeasure free disk and actual bytes/interval; minimum free2GiB; exceed estimate => preserve prefix and revise scope before continuing

time.excluded_or_uncertain: new E1 implementation/labels, P4 formal validation/checkpoints/audit, setup/load/bootstrap/report and retries; no guaranteed completion date or device real-time claim

measured_device_scope.cpu: local arm64 CPU; Torch1; BLAS threads unmeasured
measured_device_scope.other_M1_M4: not separately measured; one small replay/training timing on the destination device before extrapolating

budget: no paid service/cloud/equipment; additional monetary spending0; under100000KRW scope
rationale: 12 family preserves contact/rotation/three seeds/learning-control; 24 and original60 exceed current conservative storage. Sample size changes, learning core retained.
stage_scope: P3 comparison preparation only; P4/P5 formal work not run
